cited.quote: disbursed Rs.4,000 as relief assistance in two instalments, totaling Rs.8,393 crore to all 2.1 crore rice ration card holders

rationale: C1, the Governor's Address of 21st June 2021, reports that Rs.4,000 was disbursed in two instalments to all 2.1 crore rice ration card holders in May and June, matching the promised amount and beneficiaries. No GO for the cash is in the extracts, so the date is the address date; C3 and C4 concern grocery kits only.
